description: This Scala source file defines classes and traits for parsing and formatting timestamps in Apache Spark, including various formatter implementations, utility classes, and pattern validation logic.

classes.name: TimestampFormatter
classes.description: A trait defining methods for parsing and formatting timestamps, including pattern validation.

classes.name: Iso8601TimestampFormatter
classes.description: Formatter for ISO 8601 timestamp patterns, handling parsing and formatting with time zone considerations.

classes.name: DefaultTimestampFormatter
classes.description: Formatter that uses default patterns for parsing and formatting timestamps, following Spark's CAST logic.

classes.name: FractionTimestampFormatter
classes.description: Formatter for timestamps with fractional seconds up to microsecond precision, omitting trailing zeros.

classes.name: LegacyFastTimestampFormatter
classes.description: Legacy formatter using FastDateFormat for fast parsing and formatting.

classes.name: LegacySimpleTimestampFormatter
classes.description: Legacy formatter using SimpleDateFormat, with lenient option.

classes.name: MicrosCalendar
classes.description: Custom GregorianCalendar subclass to access raw fields and set microsecond precision.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a timestamp string into microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: parseOptional
methods.description: Parses a timestamp string into an optional microseconds value.

methods.name: parseWithoutTimeZone
methods.description: Parses timestamp string ignoring zone components, returning microseconds.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats microseconds or timestamp objects into string representation.

methods.name: validatePatternString
methods.description: Validates the pattern string used for parsing/formatting.
